reasoning: Dense white cotton-like mycelium radiating from stem base with numerous small spherical tan/yellow sclerotia (mustard seed size) scattered throughout the mycelium. This is classic Sclerotium rolfsii Southern Blight presentation. Sclerotinia was ruled out (larger, darker rice-grain sclerotia); Rhizopus was ruled out (gray mycelium, black sporangia, no spherical sclerotia).
